title: Grandma's Secret Recipe
summary: Tom wants to bake her grandmother's famous cake, but the recipe card is missing an important ingredient.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: a cosy kitchen with a young person holding a mixing bowl, an old recipe box open on the table, warm light, no text

chapters.title: The Old Recipe Box
sentences: Tom's grandmother made the best apple cake in the whole town.
Every birthday, the family waited for it with great excitement.
This year, her grandmother was too tired to bake, so Tom decided to do it herself.
She found the old recipe box in the kitchen and opened it carefully.
The card was yellow and the writing was difficult to read.
Tom followed every step and used the best apples she could find.
After an hour, the kitchen smelled wonderful.
But when she tasted the cake, her face fell, because it was dry and plain.

quiz.q: Why did Tom bake the cake?
options: She wanted to win a prize
quiz.explain: Her grandmother was too tired to bake, so Tom decided to do it herself.

quiz.q: What was the problem with the recipe card?
quiz.explain: The card was yellow and the writing was difficult to read.

chapters.title: The Missing Ingredient
sentences: Tom carried the cake to her grandmother's house and told her about the problem.
Her grandmother tasted a small piece and smiled.
"You did a very good job," she said, "but you forgot one thing."
She took a small jar from the cupboard and showed it to Tom.
"This is honey," she explained. "It was always my secret ingredient."
"Why did you not write it on the card?" Tom asked.
"I never needed to," her grandmother said, "because I always made the cake in my head."
They baked a new cake together that afternoon, and this time it was perfect.
Tom wrote the missing word on the card, so the secret would never be lost.

quiz.explain: "This is honey," she explained. "It was always my secret ingredient."

quiz.q: Why was it not on the card?
options: Her grandmother knew it by heart
quiz.explain: She always made the cake in her head.

quiz.q: What did Tom do at the end?
options: She wrote the missing word on the card
quiz.explain: Tom wrote the missing word on the card, so the secret would never be lost.
